title: Partner scouting — morning ramble and tactical to-dos
content:
Morning dump — quick brain-dump before standup (ramble -> distilled to actions).

Context: doing lightweight partner scouting / early integration asks for 3 pilot marketplace partners. Need small, testable integrations (webhook + sample payload handling + token auth) to move them from interest -> sandbox test. Goal this week: get 2 partners into sandbox, run smoke tests, measure first-10-min activation friction.

Things on my mind (short):
- Sandbox creds: some partners expect OAuth flow, others want API key. Need to support both for P0s.
- Webhook schema: partners send variable event shapes. Build mapping layer and sample validator.
- Retry policy: confirm our webhook retries (backoff + idempotency keys) with infra.
- Demo data: prepare a tiny dataset for demo flows (5 examples) and an export script.
- SLAs & docs: minimal runbook for partners (1-pager).

Immediate next actions (today):
1) Ping Jordan for sandbox OAuth client + sample token (ETA: 2h). Owner: Maya -> @jordan (Slack).
2) Create quick webhook validator script (node/ts) that flags missing required fields + logs raw payload. Put in /tmp/partner-tools. (ETA: 3h) Owner: Maya.
3) Draft 1-pager "How to get into Redwood Marketplace sandbox" — bullets only (send to Samir for copy edit). (ETA: EOD) Owner: Maya.
4) Add two smoke tests to CI (postman/newman or pytest) to assert: 200 on auth, 202 on webhook receipt, payload checksum match. (ETA: tomorrow AM) Owner: Samir.

Integration checklist (minimal, for quick pilots):
- [ ] NDA and contact info consolidated in partner sheet
- [ ] Sandbox creds issued (api key or oauth client)
- [ ] Basic schema mapping documented (fields we expect + optionals)
- [ ] Webhook endpoint verified (ngrok / tunnel -> our endpoint)
- [ ] Retry and idempotency behavior agreed
- [ ] Sample payloads (5) uploaded to shared folder
- [ ] Smoke tests passing in partner CI job
- [ ] 1-page runbook + handoff notes shared

Notes & gotchas to remember:
- Several partners still ask for long polling rather than webhooks; we should provide a polling stub but mark as low-priority.
- Auth rotation: recommend short-lived tokens with refresh; ask infra about automating rotation for long trials.
- Data residency question from EU partner: highlight private deployment option, but defer till after sandbox proof-of-concept.

Conversation snippets to link later:
- Slack: #marketplace-inbound -> thread id (will paste) re: partner A asking for oauth.
- Email: partner-biz@vendor.com (they want SSO; escalate if we commit).

Hypotheses to test this sprint (keeps me honest):
- H1: If we ship OAuth + webhook validator, partner onboarding time reduces from 3 days -> 1 day.
- H2: If we provide a single example payload per integration, engineering touchpoints fall 30%.

Metrics I'll track (quick):
- Time from initial interest -> sandbox creds issued (hours)
- Number of manual engineering interventions per partner
- Smoke tests pass rate (first-run)

Parking lot / later
- Auto-merge mapping templates into partner repo (mid-term)
- Small UI to visually map incoming webhook fields -> Redwood model input

Meeting prep (12:30 standup + 2pm sync with Jordan):
- 12:30 standup: 1-line progress (sandbox creds pinged; validator in progress)
- 2pm with Jordan: confirm OAuth client details, ask if partner prefers PKCE or server flow, confirm redirect URIs, note token expiry policy.

Quick snippets for Slack (copy-paste):
- To Jordan: "Hey Jordan — can you drop the sandbox OAuth client id/secret for Partner A into the drive? Need for validator testing; ETA today?"
- To Samir: "Can you add smoke tests for Auth + Webhook to CI? I created the postman collection in /tmp. Thx!"

End-of-day checkpoint (how I'll wrap up):
- Push validator sketch to /tmp/partner-tools and link in Confluence draft.
- Send 1-pager draft to Samir.
- Confirm OAuth pinged (if no reply, escalate to Jordan -> DM).

Random TODO (low priority):
- Look into example merchants that prefer polling; list 3 examples.
- Draft short paragraph for marketplace listing copy (value props + quick integration note).

Scratch notes (raw, unstructured):
- sample payload keys: event_type, event_id, created_at, user_id, input_text, metadata (map), signature
- idempotency: use event_id + provider prefix
- retry: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h -> mark as policy and enforce via gateway
